title: Fake Cop Gets CAUGHT Stealing $1500 Worth of Items at Publix
description:
On February 3rd, 2025. Police responded to a Publix regarding a shoplifter who claimed to be a police officer after she was caught. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
